annotations.title: MFMA feed stalls 51k cy waiting on K buffer loads
annotations.note: s_waitcnt vmcnt(7) at idx 559 gates the first v_mfma of each K-tile. It waits on the three buffer_load_dwordx4 at idx 562-564, issued only ~100 cy earlier, so the matrix engine idles ~51k cy across the wave.
annotations.suggestion: Software-pipeline the K load one tile ahead so it overlaps the previous tile's MFMAs.

annotations.title: 228x single-dword buffer_load where a wider load would do
annotations.note: The descale path loads scalars one dword at a time. Coalescing into dwordx4 would cut the transaction count 4x.

annotations.title: Wave SE0/SM2 idles ~24k cy before first issue
annotations.note: This wave sits IDLE from begin until the first instruction issues — a scheduling/launch imbalance, visible as the leading gap on its lane.

annotations.title: Occupancy peaks at 8/16 waves — likely VGPR pressure
annotations.note: occupancy.json shows active waves plateauing near half of peak for the whole dispatch; reducing register pressure would let more waves hide latency.
